en: This is a vintage-style illustrated postcard depicting a European cityscape with a prominent hill in the background. Atop the hill is a fortress-like complex and a distinct clock tower, with lush greenery surrounding the structures. In the foreground, there are classical European buildings with red-tiled roofs, a church or town hall with a green dome, and a bridge spanning a river. The lower right corner of the image contains the signature 'Konrad.'
